$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFRD (AIP France, chart dated 2026-06-11): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Dinard Saint-Malo

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

preferredQfuReason: preferred QFU 350, due to IFR operations
notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT and A + C mode transponder.
RWY 17R/35L strip reserved for authorized ULM.
Numerous birds on airfield and surroundings.
Hot air balloons may be present inside CTR.
Paragliding activity may be present on the coast between Saint-Jacut de la Mer and La Guimorais.
AD likely to be covered by sea-haze in a few minutes.
During strong westerly winds: windshears and strong turbulences on final RWY 17 and on the RWY due to Preferred QFU: 350° due to IFR operations.
Training flights using jet engines or military ACFT possible with ATC authorization: MON-FRI 0700-1100 and 1300-1800, SAT 0700-1100 (SUM: -1 HR).
The control tower arranges the taxiing sequence for entering the manoeuvring area.
On departure and on arrival, only information about aircraft movement known by ATS can be provided.
Pilots are responsible for ground and air collision avoidance, their own separation and the third party safety.
Below 2500 ft AMSL, radio contact is required 3 min before overflying the CTR entry points, on TWR frequency.
"Low height" patterns are authorized only for training flights with instructor pilot on board and with ATC clearance: MNM 300 ft AAL on preferential patterns.
Overflying SABENA installations is forbidden while in patterns.
RWY 17R/35L unpaved: Closed from 1st November to 31st March.
RWY 11/29: unusable outside ATS SKED; visual use only in the daytime; usable as TWY under control of the tower or Air to.
Air communications.
TWY use: TWY C: limited to ACFT whose overall width of main gear is 3.05 m.
TWY D: only for EMERAUDE ULM.
TWY G, E, S: only for Sabena Tecnics.
Minimal width: 10.5 m.
Reserved for ACFT with wingspan < 24 m except on section from TWY 11/29 to ACFT painting hangar (code C ACFT accepted on this section).
On segment between intermediate holding points S1 and E1, code C ACFT are authorized under towing condition only.
TWY U: ULM only.
Traffic surveillance equipment: AD equipped with radar display (see AD 1.0).
